'''Mare Tino Invasion of Commanders''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mare Tino]]
* '''Published:''' 28 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion Tino DS 2002 Invasion.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Tank Mayhem with direct damage.

== Strategy ==

Usually first turn you deploy Dofine to the Flagship and deploy Coruscant Docking Bay and Throne Room.

Then you want to the following three things:

- Setting up on Plains and Swamp

- Fortify Naboo system

- Setup We're In Attack Position Now! for direct damage (flip)

Be carefull with deploying Naboo DB. He can come to you on the ground. But even worse, if he doesn't have a system near he'll use your DB to get his starfighters to Naboo system.

Flipping is not essential, but you need to flip to deploy your Admiral's Order. You could deploy a Neimodian to Throne Room, flip, deploy orders and move neimodian to safe grounds (tanks). Be sure to be strong in space and pref have an Overload or Cease Fire! In hand.

You can pull a lot of cards.

Objective gets Dofine (or other pilot). Dofine gets Activate The Droids.

Battle Deployment gets TT-6, which gets OOM, who can get Cease Fire! Or Open Fire!

Enjoy the deck and play wise.

Martijn Peeters

And now the answers to "Why did you put that card in?":

Begin Landing Your Troops

- High Forfeit Neimodians

- Gets DB's

- Watch out for Nabrun if opponent doenst play Insurrection

Fighters Straight Ahead

- Extra Force

Coruscant: Docking Bay

- One extra Force

- Nice place for Sidious

Three Neimodian Pilots

- High Forfeit

- Cheap Deploy with AO

Lord Maul

- Ability --> With droids extra destiny

- Can help vs LS Combat (becareful)

Darth Sidious

- Anti-Jedi

- Destiny adder for Neimodians

- see Maul

Tank Commander

- The Core, while on board forfeit 5 and two destinies

TT-6

- Get your droids back for 1 force instead of 2

- Can pull OOM, OWO and Officer

DFS Squadron Starfighter

- None Unique to be pulled with There They Are! To make the other ships effective

DFS-1308

- This ship + 1 or 2 Returning Droids means victory in space

Trade Federation Droid Control Ship x2

- Capital for AO

- Adds one BD

After Her!

- Adds to destinies

- Retrieve

- Use this carefully!

Cease Fire!

- Anti X-wing laser cannon or other annoying weapons.

Halt!

- He runs away, you move your ground forces in front of him and during his deploy phase force a charater to stay!

Overload

- Anti space weapons or Panaka's Blaster

Battle Deployment

- Read it and you know why. Three important reasons.

- Most of the times weakens your opponent in space

- Weakens your opponent on the ground

- Gets you your Vehicles

We're In Attack Position Now x2

- Destiny 6

- Pilots deploy for -1 to Capitals (0 for Tank Commanders when flipped)

- Opponent loses force for each related site where you have a Tank Commander

CARDS I WANT TO ADD:

Battle Droid Officer

- Leader -> can be pulled with TT-6

Stunning Leader

- Great for both defense and attack

Oh Switch Off

- Protection of outdoor droids

SSA-719

- What if he doesn't find the card he is looking for?

Take Them Away

- Always nice to lower destinies.

- You'll need to play with two Viceroy instead of two differen Nute Gunray's
